Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: In situ tuning of FCC-BCC dual phase and mechanical properties in multi-principal element alloys via laser-aided additive manufacturing

Raw_Evidence_Span: Table 2: 100 wt% CoCrNi, 0 wt% CoCrNiAl0.6TiFe, Alloy code CoCrNi

Composition.Note: Feedstock powder composition from Table 1. CoCrNi powder prepared via gas atomization, particle size 15–45 µm.

Process_Text.original: CoCrNi powders were fed into the powder nozzle. By adjusting the feed rate ratios, 50 mm × 20 mm × 6 mm blocks were produced on 304 stainless steel substrates. Process parameters: 1.3 mm beam diameter, 570 W laser power, 5.4 g min⁻¹ total powder feed rate, 1200 mm min⁻¹ scan velocity. Deposit layer ~0.5 mm thickness, 90° rotation between adjacent layers, 50% overlap rate. Argon gas (purity ≥ 99.999%) for shielding and powder transport.
Process_Text.simplified: LAAM with CoCrNi powder only; blocks deposited on 304 SS substrate; no post heat treatment (as-built).

Equipment.Name: Correlated Solutions optical strain measurement system with DIC

Structure_Text.original: The CoCrNi alloy exhibits single FCC phase structure. Round-shaped nanoparticles distributed sporadically in the alloys; nanoparticles are depleted in Co and Ni, rich in O and Cr, indicating chromium oxide. No elemental segregation observed. Lattice parameter = 0.3282 nm.
Structure_Text.simplified: Single FCC phase with sporadic Cr-oxide nanoparticles; no elemental segregation; no B2 phase.

Secondary_Phases.Note: Round-shaped nanoparticles, sporadically distributed, rich in O and Cr, depleted in Co and Ni. Phase identified via SAED and EDS in TEM.

Structure.Note: No B2 phase, no σ phase detected experimentally.

Properties.Note: Yield strength and UTS values from Section 3.2 text: CoCrNi demonstrates a yield strength of 486 MPa, an ultimate tensile strength of 781 MPa, and an elongation at failure of 42.2%. Abstract gives YS as 486.0 MPa and UTS as 781.2 MPa.
At strain of 3.5%, work-hardening rate = 2206 MPa.

Structure_Text.original: Dual FCC + B2 phase. Irregularly shaped B2 precipitates (~0.42 µm, undefined) with volume fraction 0.5%, randomly dispersed in FCC matrix. Raw_Evidence_Span: Section 4.1: CALPHAD phase predictions using Thermo-Calc TCHEA6

Composition.Note: Equilibrium phase diagram calculated for the CoCrNi(Al0.6TiFe)x system (x = 0–0.5).

Process_Text.simplified: CALPHAD calculation using Thermo-Calc software with TCHEA6 database for equilibrium phase prediction.

Structure_Text.original: CALPHAD predictions: CoCrNi, CoCrNi(Al0.6TiFe)0.1 and CoCrNi(Al0.6TiFe)0.2 have FCC and σ phases. CoCrNi(Al0.6TiFe)0.3, 0.4, 0.5 have FCC, σ, and B2 phases. Experimentally, σ phase was not observed in any alloy, and B2 did not precipitate from CoCrNi(Al0.6TiFe)0.3. For CoCrNi(Al0.6TiFe)0.4 and 0.5, B2 increases to ~10% and ~20% in Thermo-Calc diagram.
Structure_Text.simplified: Equilibrium CALPHAD predictions differ from experimental observations: σ phase predicted but not observed; B2 predicted for x >= 0.3 but only observed for x >= 0.4.

Structure.Note: Discrepancy attributed to non-equilibrium AM process with high thermal gradient and high cooling rate inhibiting σ and B2 precipitation at lower x values.

Extracted_Data.Note: This item captures CALPHAD equilibrium predictions as a computed reference, distinct from experimental observations captured in items 01–06.
